name: Garments of the Moon
summary: In Dolanaar, Laurna Morninglight sends a young priest to aid a wounded Sentinel south of town. The duty tests an initiate's devotion and earns formal recognition in the Sisterhood of Elune.

sections.title: A Sacred Calling
sections.body: The Sisterhood of Elune guides kaldorei in worship and helps guard Teldrassil's borders. Sentinel Shaya was wounded while patrolling the wilds south of Dolanaar, and priest trainer Laurna Morninglight cannot leave her post to help. So she asks a newly trained initiate to tend Shaya's wounds and strengthen her with protective magic.

sections.title: Vestments of the Sisterhood
sections.body: After restoring Sentinel Shaya's vigor, you return to Dolanaar and receive formal robes of office from Laurna Morninglight. The robes mark an acolyte's passage from lessons to practical service that can save lives. For the kaldorei, aiding the Sentinels serves Elune and helps keep Teldrassil safe.

faq.q: Who offers the quest Garments of the Moon?
aliases: who gives garments of the moon
where to start garments of the moon
faq.answer: Laurna Morninglight, the priest trainer in Dolanaar's northern building, offers this duty.

faq.q: Who needs help during this task?
faq.answer: Sentinel Shaya needs help. Wounded while patrolling the wilderness, she waits just south of Dolanaar.

faq.q: What magic is required to help Sentinel Shaya?
aliases: what spells to cast on shaya
how to complete garments of the moon
faq.answer: You tend Sentinel Shaya's wounds with healing magic and strengthen her with protective wards before returning to Dolanaar.

faq.q: Can any class take this quest?
aliases: is garments of the moon priest only
garments of the moon class requirement
can druids do garments of the moon
faq.answer: No. Only night elf priests may take this early step in their spiritual training.

faq.q: What does the robe reward symbolize?
aliases: garments of the moon robe meaning
significance of garments of the moon
faq.answer: The robe from Laurna Morninglight marks your service to Elune and your recognized place among the local priesthood.

faq.q: What is the relationship between this quest and In Favor of Elune?
faq.answer: In Favor of Elune is an introductory summons to visit the trainer in Dolanaar. It is not required for this duty, but you cannot complete it after finishing Garments of the Moon.

angles.text: As a priest, you restore wounded allies through prayer and shield them from danger with divine wards.
As a kaldorei, you belong to a people whose Sisterhood of Elune and Sentinels have worked together for millennia to protect the forests and their people from encroaching darkness.
